info.title: Yule Love Lights Operations Hub shared contract components

get.description: The commitment store calls Quote Tool with the consumer-to-QT machine credential. The route is unavailable while COMMITMENT_EVENTS_ENABLED is off.

200.description: A cursor-ordered page of commitment-verification events.

409.description: The signed caller contract or schema version is incompatible.

410.description: The supplied cursor expired and requires audited admin reconciliation.

503.description: The independent commitment-events kill switch is off.

get.summary: Pull canonical Quote Tool lifecycle events
get.description: The Operations Hub calls Quote Tool with the Hub-to-Quote-Tool machine credential. The route is unavailable while QUOTE_LIFECYCLE_EVENTS_ENABLED is off.

200.description: A cursor-ordered page of canonical Quote Tool lifecycle events.

409.description: The signed caller contract or schema version is incompatible.

410.description: The supplied cursor expired and requires audited reconciliation.

503.description: The quote-lifecycle feed kill switch is off.

get.summary: Read one employee's current Quote Tool paid context

200.description: An available or explicitly unavailable current paid context.

409.description: The signed caller contract or schema version is incompatible.

503.description: The current-paid-context kill switch is off.

post.summary: Receive a complete Hub-owned employee authorization snapshot

YllHmac.name: X-YLL-Signature
YllHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 machine authentication defined by contract section 1.4.
x-yll-request-target-rules: use the untouched raw request target
reject noncanonical path or query encoding
uppercase percent hex and never encode RFC3986 unreserved bytes
query pairs require equals, reject plus, sort encoded key then value

ResolvedContactRef.description: Canonical lowercase Quote Tool-owned UUID; never a phone number or email address.
